rationale: Both Ashwin and Yukun are software engineers at Oracle with complementary skill sets — Yukun brings senior-level expertise in mobile and IoT development with a strong tech stack (Java, JavaScript, Swift, C++), while Ashwin has broader backend and enterprise experience from Oracle and Perficient. intro_message: Ashwin Vijayavel, meet Yukun — you're both engineers at Oracle and can learn from each other's specialties, especially Yukun's mobile and IoT background paired with your enterprise systems experience.
